title: The party
text: Somebody starts something outside a party. A lad from the year above is shoving a smaller kid around, and everyone's watching to see what happens.

choices.text: He steps in and finishes it with one punch.
choices.outcome: The video goes round school by Monday. So does his name.

choices.text: He stands in front of the smaller kid and doesn't move.
choices.outcome: He takes a punch and doesn't fall. The smaller kid becomes his best friend.

person.about: The kid he stood up for outside the party.

choices.text: He walks away and goes for a long run instead.
choices.outcome: Ten miles in the dark. He's never felt clearer.
